children: TNTSearch includes a keyword extraction feature based on the

children.name: strong
children: RAKE
(Rapid Automatic Keyword Extraction) algorithm. RAKE identifies key phrases in text by analyzing word frequency and co-occurrence, without requiring any training data.

content.name: h2
children: Basic usage

content.name: Fence
p
children: RAKE automatically filters out stopwords and scores phrases based on word degree and frequency.

content.name: Fence

children: The returned array is sorted by score (highest first), with the top third of phrases returned.

content.name: p
children: To get just the keyword phrases without scores:

content.name: Fence

$keywords = $rake->extractKeywords($text, false);
// ["minimal generating sets", "linear diophantine equations", ...]
